svg.text: How does each state's typical county compare with the U.S.?
Points above (red) or below (blue) the typical U.S. county. Red means a higher rate, not always worse (e.g. checkups). Hatched = not published.
Routine checkup in past year · U.S. 75.4%
Higher · each panel uses its own scale · Source: CDC PLACES 2025 (i46a-9kgh), age-adjusted 2023 estimates
